key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: TAKA: When you're ready, you should give Celebi that water.
en: TAKA: When you're ready, you should give Celebi that water.
ja: タカ: 準備ができたら、セレビィにその水をあげるといい。

key: But remember to stock up on items and stuff, just in case.
en: But remember to stock up on items and stuff, just in case.
ja: でも、念のためアイテムとか補充しとくのを忘れずに。

key: TAKA: \PN? I didn't expect to see you again. I just figured you'd leave, and...
en: TAKA: \PN? I didn't expect to see you again. I just figured you'd leave, and...
ja: タカ: \PN? また会えるとは思ってなかった。てっきり去っていくものだと…

key: I mean, go stand at the mountain's peak, I guess?
en: I mean, go stand at the mountain's peak, I guess?
ja: つまり、山の頂上に立ちに行くのかなって?

key: Isn't that what Champions usually do?
en: Isn't that what Champions usually do?
ja: 普通、チャンピオンってそうするものじゃないの?

key: It's... good to see you again, though. I've not really spoken to anyone since... y'know, everything.
en: It's... good to see you again, though. I've not really spoken to anyone since... y'know, everything.
ja: でも…また会えてよかった。あれから…ほら、色々あって、あまり誰とも話してなくて。

key: I was just up here... reflecting.
en: I was just up here... reflecting.
ja: ここでちょっと…考え事をしてたんだ。

key: Did you know there used to be a temple to Arceus here before they built a League?
en: Did you know there used to be a temple to Arceus here before they built a League?
ja: リーグが建てられる前、ここにはアルセウスをまつる神殿があったって知ってた?

key: Father mentioned it a few times.
en: Father mentioned it a few times.
ja: 父さんが何度か話してたんだ。

key: His father ran it, so he spent a lot of time here as a kid...
en: His father ran it, so he spent a lot of time here as a kid...
ja: 父さんのお父さんがそこを取り仕切ってたから、子供の頃はここでたくさん時間を過ごしてたって…

key: It was already gone by the time I was born, though.
en: It was already gone by the time I was born, though.
ja: でも、俺が生まれた時にはもうなくなってたんだ。

key: And he only mentioned it a few times.
en: And he only mentioned it a few times.
ja: しかも、父さんはほんの数回しかその話をしなかった。

key: He didn't like talking about his parents...
en: He didn't like talking about his parents...
ja: 自分の両親のことを話すのは好きじゃなかったみたいで…

key: They must've been intense.
en: They must've been intense.
ja: きっと厳しい人たちだったんだろうな。

key: Probably best I never got to meet them.
en: Probably best I never got to meet them.
ja: たぶん、会わずに済んで良かったんだと思う。

key: I doubt Fath--
en: I doubt Fath--
ja: たぶん父さ――

key: ... I doubt Solaris would even want them to see how I turned out.
en: ... I doubt Solaris would even want them to see how I turned out.
ja: …ソラリスだって、俺がこんな風になったのを、あの人たちに見せたくはなかっただろうな。

key: TAKA: Wait a minute, that Pokémon over there, the one just staring at us...
en: TAKA: Wait a minute, that Pokémon over there, the one just staring at us...
ja: タカ: 待って、あそこにいるポケモン、こっちをじっと見てる…

key: That's Celebi, a Legendary Pokémon!
en: That's Celebi, a Legendary Pokémon!
ja: あれはセレビィ、伝説のポケモンだ!

key: It looks pretty rough though, like it's sick?
en: It looks pretty rough though, like it's sick?
ja: でも、かなり弱ってるみたいだ。病気なのか?

key: We need to help it; we can't let it...
en: We need to help it; we can't let it...
ja: 助けなきゃ、このままじゃ…

key: Too many bad things have happened on this mountain already.
en: Too many bad things have happened on this mountain already.
ja: この山では、もう十分すぎるほど悪いことが起きてきた。

key: But why did it come here?
en: But why did it come here?
ja: でも、なんでここに来たんだろう?

key: I know a bit about Legendary Pokémon, but only what I read in Father's books...
en: I know a bit about Legendary Pokémon, but only what I read in Father's books...
ja: 伝説のポケモンについては少し知ってるけど、父さんの本で読んだだけで…

key: Apparently Grandfather was an expert on medicine and Legendary Pokémon, and we kept some of his books.
en: Apparently Grandfather was an expert on medicine and Legendary Pokémon, and we kept some of his books.
ja: おじいさんが医学と伝説のポケモンの専門家だったらしくて、その本を何冊か残してあるんだ。

key: TAKA: ...Wait.
en: TAKA: ...Wait.
ja: タカ: …待てよ。

key: Celebi can travel through time, right?
en: Celebi can travel through time, right?
ja: セレビィって時を渡れるんだよな?

key: It's in the right place, just a few decades late...
en: It's in the right place, just a few decades late...
ja: 場所は合ってる、数十年遅れてるだけで…

key: Uh, here, maybe try giving it this?
en: Uh, here, maybe try giving it this?
ja: あの、これあげてみたら?

key: Maybe this will give it just enough energy to travel through back to where it needs to be...
en: Maybe this will give it just enough energy to travel through back to where it needs to be...
ja: これで、行くべき場所に戻るだけのエネルギーが足りるかもしれない…

key: Oh but, maybe make sure you stock up on items and stuff?
en: Oh but, maybe make sure you stock up on items and stuff?
ja: あ、でも、念のためアイテムとか補充しといた方がいいかも?

key: It's probably in a hurry to get to the past, I doubt it'll wait after you give it the water...
en: It's probably in a hurry to get to the past, I doubt it'll wait after you give it the water...
ja: たぶん過去に行くのを急いでるだろうから、水をあげた後は待ってくれないと思う…

key: But knowing your luck it'll probably be fine!
en: But knowing your luck it'll probably be fine!
ja: でも、あなたの運を考えたら、たぶん大丈夫だよ!

key: A quick jaunt into the past with no complications, and you befriend a Legendary Pokémon in the process.
en: A quick jaunt into the past with no complications, and you befriend a Legendary Pokémon in the process.
ja: 何のトラブルもなくさっと過去に行って、その途中で伝説のポケモンと友達になる。

key: Knowing my luck, I'd probably just get eaten by a Tyrantrum or something.
en: Knowing my luck, I'd probably just get eaten by a Tyrantrum or something.
ja: 俺の運じゃ、たぶんガチゴラスか何かに食われて終わりだろうけど。

key: ELIAS: Water should temporarily rejuvenate Celebi.
en: ELIAS: Water should temporarily rejuvenate Celebi.
ja: イライアス: 水はセレビィを一時的に活力づけるはずです。

key: Perhaps too much so-- be prepared to leave as soon as you give it the water.
en: Perhaps too much so-- be prepared to leave as soon as you give it the water.
ja: むしろ活力づけすぎるかもしれません――水をあげたらすぐに出発できるよう、備えておいてください。

key: ELIAS: Prosperitas, Pax Pacis, Obsequium.
en: ELIAS: Prosperitas, Pax Pacis, Obsequium.
ja: イライアス: プロスペリタス、パクス・パチス、オブセクィウム。

key: A gleaming gate to the New World appears before me, and out steps my Lord.
en: A gleaming gate to the New World appears before me, and out steps my Lord.
ja: 輝く新世界への門が私の前に現れ、そこから我が主が歩み出る。

key: The miracle of my sight was more than enough, but you grace me further,
en: The miracle of my sight was more than enough, but you grace me further,
ja: この目に映る奇跡だけでも十分でしたが、あなたはさらなる恵みを私に与えてくださる、

key: Performing another miracle before my very eyes.
en: Performing another miracle before my very eyes.
ja: この目の前で、また新たな奇跡を起こしてくださって。

key: While I'm sure you already knew this, you have caught me at a time of reflection.
en: While I'm sure you already knew this, you have caught me at a time of reflection.
ja: きっとご存知だったのでしょうが、あなたは私が物思いにふけっているところに来られました。

key: Today, I am not here as a member of the Elite Four, but instead as a pilgrim.
en: Today, I am not here as a member of the Elite Four, but instead as a pilgrim.
ja: 今日の私は、四天王の一員としてではなく、一人の巡礼者としてここにおります。

key: Before there was a Pokémon League here, there was instead a temple.
en: Before there was a Pokémon League here, there was instead a temple.
ja: ここにポケモンリーグができる前は、神殿がありました。

key: I spent much time there in my youth.
en: I spent much time there in my youth.
ja: 若い頃、そこで多くの時間を過ごしたのです。

key: Even if the temple is gone, this place feels... important.
en: Even if the temple is gone, this place feels...  important.
ja: 神殿がなくなった今でも、この場所は…大切なもののように感じられます。

key: Sacred, even.
en: Sacred, even.
ja: 神聖ですらあります。

key: ELIAS: Errare humanum est.
en: ELIAS: Errare humanum est.
ja: イライアス: エラーレ・フマヌム・エスト。

key: My deepest apologies, my Lord.
en: My deepest apologies, my Lord.
ja: 誠に申し訳ございません、我が主よ。

key: I got so caught up in my reminiscence that I did not see the reason you have come here.
en: I got so caught up in my reminiscence that I did not see the reason you have come here.
ja: 回想にすっかり心を奪われ、あなたがここに来られた理由に気づきませんでした。

key: Celebi, the Time Travel Pokémon--
en: Celebi, the Time Travel Pokémon--
ja: 時渡りポケモン、セレビィ――

key: I have read much about it.
en: I have read much about it.
ja: 多くの文献を読んできました。

key: It does not look as lustrous as the diagrams would suggest, though.
en: It does not look as lustrous as the diagrams would suggest, though.
ja: とはいえ、図に描かれているほどの輝きはないようですが。

key: ELIAS: Ah, of course, I see.
en: ELIAS: Ah, of course, I see.
ja: イライアス: ああ、なるほど、そういうことですか。

key: This is a test of my knowledge.
en: This is a test of my knowledge.
ja: これは私の知識を試すものなのですね。

key: I shall inspect the Pokémon at once.
en: I shall inspect the Pokémon at once.
ja: 直ちにこのポケモンを診てまいりましょう。

key: ELIAS: You poor creature...
en: ELIAS: You poor creature...
ja: イライアス: 哀れな生き物よ…

key: It must have been very strenuous to make it even here.
en: It must have been very strenuous to make it even here.
ja: ここまでたどり着くだけでも、さぞ過酷だったに違いありません。

key: ELIAS: I'm sorry. This is beyond my ability to heal.
en: ELIAS: I'm sorry. This is beyond my ability to heal.
ja: イライアス: 申し訳ございません。これは私の治癒の力を超えています。

key: The Relic Stone would surely be able to help in this matter, however, last I heard, you had traveled to the New World to locate it?
en: The Relic Stone would surely be able to help in this matter, however, last I heard, you had traveled to the New World to locate it?
ja: 遺跡の石であれば、この件に確実に役立つはずですが、最後に聞いた話では、それを探すために新世界へ向かわれたのでは?

key: But you are here with Celebi, and no Relic Stone in sight.
en: But you are here with Celebi, and no Relic Stone in sight.
ja: ですが、あなたはセレビィとともにここにおられ、遺跡の石はどこにも見当たりません。

key: ELIAS: I understand, my Lord; you wish for me to solve this problem without its power.
en: ELIAS: I understand, my Lord; you wish for me to solve this problem without its power.
ja: イライアス: 承知いたしました、我が主。その力なしに、この問題を解決せよということですね。

key: Allow me a moment to consider my options.
en: Allow me a moment to consider my options.
ja: 少々、選択肢を考えさせてください。

key: I apologize profusely for this delay.
en: I apologize profusely for this delay.
ja: この遅れ、深くおわび申し上げます。

key: ELIAS: Of course, this is a brilliant test you have devised for me, my Lord!
en: ELIAS: Of course, this is a brilliant test you have devised for me, my Lord!
ja: イライアス: なるほど、これは我が主が私のために考案された、実に見事な試練ですね!

key: You arrived here when I was reflecting on the old temple, with a Pokémon in need of aid.
en: You arrived here when I was reflecting on the old temple, with a Pokémon in need of aid.
ja: 私が古い神殿について物思いにふけっていた時、助けを必要とするポケモンを連れて、あなたはここに到着された。

key: Specifically, a Pokémon that can travel through time, but not space.
en: Specifically, a Pokémon that can travel through time, but not space.
ja: しかも、空間ではなく時間を渡れるポケモンを。

key: I lack the knowledge to heal Celebi without the Relic Stone, but Father Taube, the keeper of the temple...
en: I lack the knowledge to heal Celebi without the Relic Stone, but Father Taube, the keeper of the temple...
ja: 遺跡の石なしにセレビィを癒す知識は私にはありませんが、神殿の守り手であったタウベ神父なら…

key: Nobody knew more about Legendary Pokémon.
en: Nobody knew more about Legendary Pokémon.
ja: 彼ほど伝説のポケモンに詳しい者はいませんでした。

key: My Lord, please accept this offering.
en: My Lord, please accept this offering.
ja: 我が主よ、どうかこのささげ物をお受け取りください。

key: ELIAS: Aqua Pura.
en: ELIAS: Aqua Pura.
ja: イライアス: アクア・プーラ。

key: Legendary it may be, but Celebi is still a Grass Type.
en: Legendary it may be, but Celebi is still a Grass Type.
ja: 伝説とはいえ、セレビィはくさタイプに変わりありません。

key: Some water should give it enough energy for a trip through time.
en: Some water should give it enough energy for a trip through time.
ja: 水を与えれば、時を渡るのに十分なエネルギーが得られるはずです。

key: I'm sure you already are aware, but-- be prepared before you give it the water.
en: I'm sure you already are aware, but-- be prepared before you give it the water.
ja: すでにご承知とは思いますが――水を与える前に、備えをなさってください。

key: I doubt an injured Pokémon will waste any time trying to get to where it thinks it can be healed.
en: I doubt an injured Pokémon will waste any time trying to get to where it thinks it can be healed.
ja: 傷ついたポケモンが、癒される場所へ急ぐのに時間を無駄にするとは思えません。

key: There appears to be something nearby that the sickly Pokémon wants you to see.
en: There appears to be something nearby that the sickly Pokémon wants you to see.
ja: この弱ったポケモンは、近くにある何かをあなたに見せたがっているようだ。

key: Do you want to give Celebi more water?
en: Do you want to give Celebi more water?
ja: セレビィにもっと水をあげる?

key: \PN gently poured a second bottle of water over the sickly Pokémon.
en: \PN gently poured a second bottle of water over the sickly Pokémon.
ja: \PNは弱ったポケモンに、2本目の水をそっとかけた。

key: Celebi still looks weak, but gets a glint in its eye.
en: Celebi still looks weak, but gets a glint in its eye.
ja: セレビィはまだ弱っているが、目に光が宿った。

key: Your surroundings start to fade away...
en: Your surroundings start to fade away...
ja: 周囲の景色が薄れていく…

key: Celebi looks like it will wait until you're ready to give it the water.
en: Celebi looks like it will wait until you're ready to give it the water.
ja: セレビィは、水をあげる準備ができるまで待ってくれそうだ。

key: If only a former terrorist had given you a bottle of water like five seconds ago to use in this exact situation but, alas, you have no water.
en: If only a former terrorist had given you a bottle of water like five seconds ago to use in this exact situation but, alas, you have no water.
ja: 5秒前に元テロリストが、まさにこの状況で使えそうな水を渡してくれていればよかったのに、悲しいことに水がない。

key: TAKA: Hey, \PN?
en: TAKA: Hey, \PN?
ja: タカ: なあ、\PN?

key: You just spaced out for a second, there.
en: You just spaced out for a second, there.
ja: 今、一瞬ぼーっとしてたね。

key: I mean, that's a mood. I just had the weirdest deja vu...
en: I mean, that's a mood. I just had the weirdest deja vu...
ja: まあ、わかるよ。俺も今、変なデジャヴを感じたばっかりで…

key: Anyway, just give Celebi that water when you're ready, I guess.
en: Anyway, just give Celebi that water when you're ready, I guess.
ja: とにかく、準備ができたらセレビィにその水をあげて。

key: ELIAS: My Lord, is everything all right?
en: ELIAS: My Lord, is everything all right?
ja: イライアス: 我が主よ、何かございましたか?

key: I assume you felt it too?
en: I assume you felt it too?
ja: あなたも何かをお感じになったのでは?

key: I just had the strangest sense of familiarity with these events, for some reason...
en: I just had the strangest sense of familiarity with these events, for some reason...
ja: なぜか、この出来事に妙な既視感を覚えまして…

key: Ah, not that you would find yourself affected by being in the presence of a Pokémon with power over time.
en: Ah, not that you would find yourself affected by being in the presence of a Pokémon with power over time.
ja: ああ、いえ、時を司るポケモンの存在に影響を受けるようなお方ではないでしょうが。

key: You must have been waiting for me to adjust.
en: You must have been waiting for me to adjust.
ja: 私が落ち着くのを待ってくださっていたのですね。

key: I am, as always, humbled by how considerate you are.
en: I am, as always, humbled by how considerate you are.
ja: 相変わらず、あなたの思いやり深さには頭が下がります。

key: I'm sure Celebi will be ready for you as soon as you give it the water.
en: I'm sure Celebi will be ready for you as soon as you give it the water.
ja: 水をあげれば、セレビィもすぐに準備が整うでしょう。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 35!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 35!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解析35を手に入れた!

key: Info on New World now available!
en: Info on New World now available!
ja: 新世界に関する情報が閲覧可能になった!

key: HARDY: You're in the nick o' time, mate.
en: HARDY: You're in the nick o' time, mate.
ja: ハーディ: ちょうどいいタイミングだな、相棒。

key: I just wiped to this thing like a dumbass.
en: I just wiped to this thing like a dumbass.
ja: こいつにあっさりやられちまってな、バカみたいに。

key: But it's softened up and doesn't like to stay in place long.
en: But it's softened up and doesn't like to stay in place long.
ja: でも、だいぶ弱ってるし、じっとしてるのは苦手みたいだ。

key: Battle first and talk later! You got me?
en: Battle first and talk later! You got me?
ja: 話は後だ、まずはバトルだ! わかったな?

key: RAYQUAZA: Razaah!!
en: RAYQUAZA: Razaah!!
ja: レックウザ: ラザァァ!!

key: QUAAAARR!!!
en: QUAAAARR!!!
ja: クアァァァ!!!

key: RAYQUAZA: Raiiiiyi--
en: RAYQUAZA: Raiiiiyi--
ja: レックウザ: ライィィイ――

key: HARDY: It's gonna fly off again!
en: HARDY: It's gonna fly off again!
ja: ハーディ: また飛んでいっちまうぞ!

key: Waitstopcomebackdon't--
en: Waitstopcomebackdon't--
ja: 待てとまれもどってこないでくれ――

key: HARDY: Bloody hell...
en: HARDY: Bloody hell...
ja: ハーディ: ちくしょう…

key: HARDY: There's no telling where that thing is gonna go.
en: HARDY: There's no telling where that thing is gonna go.
ja: ハーディ: あいつがどこに行くかなんて、まったくわかんねえな。

key: But at least you got the Anomaly off of it.
en: But at least you got the Anomaly off of it.
ja: でも、少なくともアノマリーは取り除けたな。

key: At this point, we can chase it down like any other roaming Pokémon.
en: At this point, we can chase it down like any other roaming Pokémon.
ja: ここまで来れば、他のはいかいポケモンと同じように追いかけられる。

key: I heard what happened to Sis.
en: I heard what happened to Sis.
ja: 姉貴に何があったか聞いた。

key: Or what's happening, I guess.
en: Or what's happening, I guess.
ja: っていうか、今も起きてることか。

key: Thought maybe I could actually show some goodwill between us for once and chase that thing down to knock her out of it.
en: Thought maybe I could actually show some goodwill between us for once and chase that thing down to knock her out of it.
ja: 俺たちの間でたまには友好の証を見せようと思って、あいつを追いかけて姉貴をたたき出してやろうとしたんだ。

key: No dice.
en: No dice.
ja: だめだったけどな。

key: First time I found it, I heard her.
en: First time I found it, I heard her.
ja: 初めて見つけた時、あいつの声が聞こえた。

key: A young girl's voice...
en: A young girl's voice...
ja: 若い女の子の声…

key: I swear I've heard it before, but I can't place it.
en: I swear I've heard it before, but I can't place it.
ja: 絶対どこかで聞いたことあるんだけど、思い出せねえ。

key: She sounded self-righteous and cocky.
en: She sounded self-righteous and cocky.
ja: 独善的で生意気な感じだった。

key: Almost like Sis in that way, but brighter.
en: Almost like Sis in that way, but brighter.
ja: 姉貴に似てるっちゃ似てるけど、もっと明るい感じでな。

key: Coming from a place of unshakable optimism even as she pitches a Legend straight at me...
en: Coming from a place of unshakable optimism even as she pitches a Legend straight at me...
ja: 伝説のポケモンをこっちにけしかけといて、揺るぎない楽観主義から来てる感じっつうか…

key: Lin.
en: Lin.
ja: リン。

key: She sounds... different.
en: She sounds... different.
ja: 何か…違う感じがした。

key: The whole time we were fighting Meteor, I'd never have guessed they were under the banner of a little girl.
en: The whole time we were fighting Meteor, I'd never have guessed they were under the banner of a little girl.
ja: メテオとずっと戦ってきて、まさか小さい女の子が旗印だったなんて、思いもしなかった。

key: Shit's messed up, yanno?
en: Shit's messed up, yanno?
ja: マジで狂ってるよな、なあ?

key: I'm questioning if we were even doin' the right thing.
en: I'm questioning if we were even doin' the right thing.
ja: 俺たちがやってたことが本当に正しかったのか、疑問に思うくらいだ。

key: But I think, we gotta have been right?
en: But I think, we gotta have been right?
ja: でも、正しかったはずだよな?

key: Otherwise we'd have a lot more problems than a few ragtag legends and open worlds.
en: Otherwise we'd have a lot more problems than a few ragtag legends and open worlds.
ja: じゃなきゃ、寄せ集めの伝説ポケモンとか開かれた世界とか、そんなもんじゃ済まねえ問題を抱えてることになる。

key: ...Anyway, point is, I learned a thing or two 'bout chasing down Pokémon like this.
en: ...Anyway, point is, I learned a thing or two 'bout chasing down Pokémon like this.
ja: …とにかく、要は、こういうポケモンの追い方を色々学んだってことだ。

key: Drop a word if you want the run-down.
en: Drop a word if you want the run-down.
ja: 説明が欲しけりゃ言ってくれ。

key: HARDY: Want the scoop on roamers, mate?
en: HARDY: Want the scoop on roamers, mate?
ja: ハーディ: はいかいポケモンのコツ、聞きたいか、相棒?

key: Rayquaza has some quirks compared to what I've read it's like in other regions.
en: Rayquaza has some quirks compared to what I've read it's like in other regions.
ja: レックウザは、他の地方の話で読んだのとはちょっと違う癖があるみたいだ。

key: HARDY: Word. So, basics:
en: HARDY: Word. So, basics:
ja: ハーディ: よし。じゃあ基本から:

key: Rayquaza's touring out there somewhere.
en: Rayquaza's touring out there somewhere.
ja: レックウザはどこかその辺をうろついてる。

key: It's usually not going with a destination in mind, so it might move to a nearby place randomly or not at all as you travel.
en: It's usually not going with a destination in mind, so it might move to a nearby place randomly or not at all as you travel.
ja: たいてい目的地なんて決めずに動いてるから、お前が移動するたびに近くの場所にランダムに移動するか、まったく動かないかのどっちかだ。

key: I doubt it'll fly inside anywhere, so you've only gotta care about major outdoor places.
en: I doubt it'll fly inside anywhere, so you've only gotta care about major outdoor places.
ja: 屋内に飛び込むことはねえと思うから、気にするのは主要な屋外の場所だけでいい。

key: Check your Map App to see where it's at, and make tracks.
en: Check your Map App to see where it's at, and make tracks.
ja: マップアプリで居場所を確認して、そこに向かえ。

key: You'll know when you're close because of Rayquaza's windstream.
en: You'll know when you're close because of Rayquaza's windstream.
ja: 近づけば、レックウザの風の流れでわかるはずだ。

key: Once you're nearby, Repels can help too.
en: Once you're nearby, Repels can help too.
ja: 近くまで行ったら、むしよけスプレーも役に立つぞ。

key: The problem is, once you find it, it's likely to just run away again.
en: The problem is, once you find it, it's likely to just run away again.
ja: 問題は、見つけてもまた逃げられる可能性が高いってことだ。

key: Annoying bugger.
en: Annoying bugger.
ja: 腹立つ奴だぜ。

key: Mean Look is a classic strat' in other regions, but it ain't necessary here.
en: Mean Look is a classic strat' in other regions, but it ain't necessary here.
ja: くろいまなざしは他の地方じゃ定番の戦法だけど、ここじゃ必要ない。

key: The more you find it, the more tired it'll get.
en: The more you find it, the more tired it'll get.
ja: 見つけるたびに、あいつはどんどん疲れていく。

key: Damage and what-not'll stick around between encounters as long as you don't KO it.
en: Damage and what-not'll stick around between encounters as long as you don't KO it.
ja: 気絶させない限り、ダメージなんかは遭遇の合間もそのまま残る。

key: If you do, it'll probably just take a Roost and revive itself.
en: If you do, it'll probably just take a Roost and revive itself.
ja: 気絶させちまったら、たぶんはねやすめで自己回復するだけだろうな。

key: I think that's about it, 'side from one more note.
en: I think that's about it, 'side from one more note.
ja: だいたいそんなもんだ、あともう一つあるけど。

key: It might not've looked it in the Anomaly, cuz, yanno, Anomaly, but there's still a chance that it'll be shiny.
en: It might not've looked it in the Anomaly, cuz, yanno, Anomaly, but there's still a chance that it'll be shiny.
ja: アノマリーの中じゃそう見えなかったかもしれないけど、まあアノマリーだしな、それでも色違いの可能性はある。

key: This might go without sayin', but if it is, it'll be that way from the start. No changin' colors while it runs away.
en: This might go without sayin', but if it is, it'll be that way from the start. No changin' colors while it runs away.
ja: 言うまでもないかもしれないけど、色違いなら最初からそうだ。逃げてる途中で色が変わったりはしない。

key: Keep that in mind, and you'll be ship-shape to rock this!
en: Keep that in mind, and you'll be ship-shape to rock this!
ja: それを覚えとけば、完璧にやってのけられるはずだ!

key: HARDY: Suit yourself.
en: HARDY: Suit yourself.
ja: ハーディ: 好きにしろよ。

key: You got this!
en: You got this!
ja: お前ならできる!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
